verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's built-in Copilot is documented as configuring 'automations' from plain-English requests, so the product has its own automation capability that a user can set up. Sequenced campaigns and automatic email logging also run without manual steps. However, the evidence never describes what automations can do, what triggers them, whether they run on a schedule, or how they execute in the background. missing for 10: documentation of automation triggers/actions and background or scheduled execution, recurring-schedule support, run history or monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.
Send sequenced campaigns to a filtered list from inside the CRM, with engagement flowing back onto the contact record.
Connect Gmail or Outlook so every customer email is logged against the right contact and deal automatically
